findings.title: Final delivery gate remains open
findings.rationale: The E71 candidate supplies strong disposable PG/BFF/browser and source-bound image evidence, but DOD-13 remains explicitly incomplete: independent delivery assessments, the canonical full diff guard, final review, and closure must not be inferred from candidate GREEN.
findings.suggested_action: Do not mark the TODO delivered or activate the candidate. Complete and adjudicate the required independent delivery/final guards under their approved boundaries.

findings.title: Preserved-runtime and assisted operator proof remain pending
findings.rationale: The package expressly limits E71 to a disposable database and fake provider. DOD-11/DOD-12 still require approved preserved-local activation, additive migration validation in that target, assisted first sends, and recipient replies; no real provider or recipient result is evidenced.
findings.suggested_action: After the separately approved runtime plan and preflight, obtain the bounded source/runtime attestation and operator-assisted nonofficial and approved-template send/reply evidence without automated contact actions.

findings.title: Canonical documentation consolidation and full diff inspection remain open
findings.rationale: The module consolidation is only a proposal, and the canonical cross-repository diff guard has not run because its required private-boundary exception is not approved. The current code does not present an unauthorized compatibility bridge, but these governance gates remain necessary before closeout.
findings.suggested_action: Obtain explicit authority for the bounded diff inspection if still needed, run the canonical guard, then consolidate the approved supersessions into canonical modules and complete the associated consistency review.
